sqlStatement:
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.PurchaseOrderNo,
    a.PurchaseOrderDate,
    a.LastReceiptDate,
    a.VendorNo,
    a.PurchaseName,
    b.ItemCode,
    b.ItemCodeDesc,
    b.QuantityOrdered,
    b.QuantityReceived,
    b.UnitCost,
    b.ExtensionAmt
FROM MAS90CBL.dbo.PO_PurchaseOrderHeader a
LEFT JOIN MAS90CBL.dbo.PO_PurchaseOrderDetail b
    ON a.PurchaseOrderNo = b.PurchaseOrderNo
WHERE a.PurchaseOrderDate >= '2018-01-01'
description: Retrieves purchase order headers and details from the Canada entity. Uses DISTINCT to eliminate duplicate rows and filters for orders since January 1, 2018.

sqlStatement:
SELECT *
FROM [MAS90CBS].[dbo].[IM_ItemTransactionHistory]
WHERE TransactionDate >= '2018-01-01'

UNION

SELECT *
FROM [MAS90CBL].[dbo].[IM_ItemTransactionHistory]
WHERE TransactionDate >= '2018-01-01'

UNION

SELECT *
FROM [MAS90PSC].[dbo].[IM_ItemTransactionHistory]
WHERE TransactionDate >= '2018-01-01'

ORDER BY TransactionDate DESC

dataSource.database: master (federated query across MAS90CBS, MAS90CBL, MAS90PSC)

description: Combines item transaction history from all three entities (San Jose, Canada, and Wallingford) using UNION. Filters for transactions since January 1, 2018 and sorts by transaction date in descending order.
